description.text: Why choose to study this program? This prograq is offered by School of Electronic and Information Engineering (SEIE) of Beihang University, one of the earliest department of aeronautic electronic enigeering founded in China with a history of 50 years. Electronic information is a broad-range field. Great attention has been paid to cultivate personnel with technology in comprehensive IT manufacture, public network and private network, focused on electronic information technology applications. Main Courses Introduction of Electronic Information Engineering, Introduction to Mechanical Engineering, Introduction to Aeronautics and Astronautics, Software Technical Fundament, Circuit Analysic, Electromagnetic Field Theory, Signals and Systems, Analog Electronic Circuit, Digital Signal Processing, Electronic Measure etc.Internship and Career Development Students of this program could have many practices, like Engineering Cognition Practice, Metalworking Practice and Electronics Practice. The major is designed to train professionals with basic knowledge in electronic technology and information system, basic theory and techniques of information collection, processing and transmission, and basic practice in electronics and information engineering. It turns out senior engineering and technical personnel who are capable of information processing systems, communications systems and electronic equipment research, design, application development and operation analysis. Diploma Awarded Bachelor of Engineering. Accommodation International Students Dormitory, double room, 30 Yuan/Day, per bed** International Students Dormitory shall be applied in advance.* The accommodation fee is based on the actual arrangement for accommodation upon the registration, and the cost does not include utilities.

duration.text: The Electronic Information Engineering at Beihang University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. HSK

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be in good physical and mental health, with proper moral conduct, friendly to China, between the ages of 18 and 22, and have attained a senior high school diploma.2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport , meet the conditions set by the Document No. 12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC .3. Applicants who’s native language is not English should submit the results of TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo or English Proficiency Certificate (90 or above in TOEFL, 6 or above in IELTS,105 or above in Duolingo)
